body:
This PR updates `SimDir` to use `OutputVar` instead of `read_var` which convert dates to seconds. This is needed when ClimaDiagnostics start to save the time dimension of the NetCDF files in dates instead of seconds (see https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaDiagnostics.jl/pull/204). Furthermore, if the `start_date` attribute is present, then `OutputVar`s will respect the start date and the absolute times will be relative to the start date instead of the first time. This is relevant for restarts.

This PR is needed for the changes in https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaDiagnostics.jl/pull/204. I asked a LLM to make these changes.
title: Use start_date when converting dates to seconds
